text: Volvo Cars reported a Q3 operating loss of SEK 5.6B versus a prior-quarter profit of SEK 6.4B. China revenue fell nearly 50% YoY, and shares declined approximately 26%. The company announced 2,500 global job cuts, including 2,000 in Sweden, and a SEK 5B cost-reduction target.

meta.note: Regional restructuring is announced; its operational implementation remains unspecified.

text: American Express announced a 5% global workforce reduction and a $336M restructuring charge. Management outlined fewer organizational layers and wider spans of control. Q3 revenue rose 9% to $20.06B,adjusted EPS reached $4.68, and full-year EPS guidance increased to $18.30-$18.60.

meta.note: Workforce cuts are announced; AI-driven process replacement is not yet quantified as realized activity.

text: The DOJ filed suit seeking to prevent certification of certain Alaska Senate election results pending investigation of alleged ballot confusion between Dan S. Sullivan and Daniel J. Sullivan. Trump publicly acknowledged directing the action. Alaska courts previously upheld Daniel J. Sullivan's ballot placement.

meta.note: Voter confusion remains alleged; the requested certification restriction has not been judicially granted.
